groups.label: Run scale
groups.description: Evolution size, duration, and replay sampling.

groups.label: Brain activity
groups.description: Autonomous drive, bias, and synaptic transmission.

groups.label: Fitness & costs
groups.description: External shaping and internal resource pressure.

groups.label: Mutation
groups.description: Shared and scalar structural mutation controls.

parameters.label: Evolution algorithm
parameters.help: Scalar tournament selection or NEAT with NSGA-II.

parameters.label: Generations
parameters.help: Number of generations to evolve.

parameters.label: Population
parameters.help: Genomes evaluated per generation.

parameters.label: Episode steps
parameters.help: Environment steps in each evaluation trial.

parameters.label: Trials per genome
parameters.help: Independent trials averaged for each genome.

parameters.label: Replay trials
parameters.help: Trials used to choose the final recorded episode.

parameters.label: Pareto solutions to save
parameters.help: Representative final Pareto-front solutions. Zero disables recording.

parameters.label: Trials per Pareto replay
parameters.help: Replay trials used to select each saved Pareto episode.

parameters.label: Sensorimotor regime
parameters.help: Directional field-of-view control or direct allocentric target vectors.

parameters.label: Task
parameters.help: Continuously visible food or a memory-oriented cue-occlusion challenge.

parameters.label: External fitness
parameters.help: Distance-shaped reward or task reward only.

parameters.label: Field of view (degrees)
parameters.help: Width of the directional food visibility arc.

parameters.label: Initial heading range
parameters.help: Fraction of the half-FOV used for initial target-bearing sampling.

parameters.label: Visible cue steps
parameters.help: Environment steps for which a new target remains visible.

parameters.label: Minimum occlusion
parameters.help: Minimum sampled hidden-target duration.

parameters.label: Maximum occlusion
parameters.help: Maximum sampled hidden-target duration.

parameters.label: Close reveal distance
parameters.help: Distance at which an occluded target becomes visible again.

parameters.label: Maximum turn rate
parameters.help: Maximum turn rate in radians per simulated second.

parameters.label: Episode-start input
parameters.help: Expose a brief pulse input at the beginning of each episode.

parameters.label: Start pulse brain steps
parameters.help: Duration of the episode-start pulse in brain steps.

parameters.label: Poisson background activity
parameters.help: Enable stochastic background-current events.

parameters.label: Background rate (Hz)
parameters.help: Background event rate per neuron.

parameters.label: Background event current
parameters.help: Current delivered by one background event before sensitivity scaling.

parameters.label: Maximum bias fraction
parameters.help: Maximum isolated steady-state potential as a fraction of threshold.

parameters.label: Synaptic gain
parameters.help: Gain applied to delivered synaptic spike current.

parameters.label: Seed I/O weight
parameters.help: Initial direct sensory-to-motor connection weight.

parameters.label: Legacy tonic clock
parameters.help: Enable the legacy tonic clock input for comparison experiments.

parameters.label: Clock input value
parameters.help: Constant value supplied to the legacy clock input.

parameters.label: Clock threshold mutation
parameters.help: Scalar-mode probability of mutating the clock input threshold.

parameters.label: Clock threshold sigma
parameters.help: Clock threshold mutation standard deviation.

parameters.label: Clock threshold minimum
parameters.help: Minimum evolvable clock threshold.

parameters.label: Clock threshold maximum
parameters.help: Maximum evolvable clock threshold.

parameters.label: Closest-approach reward
parameters.help: Reward scale for each new closest approach to food.

parameters.label: Visibility alignment reward
parameters.help: Speed-gated reward for keeping visible food centered.

parameters.label: Turning penalty
parameters.help: Penalty per excess unit of turning intensity.

parameters.label: Inactivity penalty
parameters.help: Penalty per excess inactive step.

parameters.label: Turning budget
parameters.help: Mean absolute turn command allowed before penalties.

parameters.label: Inactivity budget
parameters.help: Mean stillness allowed before penalties.

parameters.label: Spike budget rate
parameters.help: Spikes per neuron per brain step allowed before scalar penalty.

parameters.label: Scalar synapse budget
parameters.help: Synapses allowed before scalar structural penalty.

parameters.label: Scalar neuron budget
parameters.help: Neurons allowed before scalar structural penalty.

parameters.label: Large bias-jump probability
parameters.help: Legacy large hidden-bias jump probability; the result remains subthreshold-clamped.

parameters.label: Minimum bias jump
parameters.help: Minimum magnitude selected by a large bias-jump mutation.

parameters.label: Weight mutation probability
parameters.help: NEAT per-connection weight mutation probability; also updates scalar weight mutation.

parameters.label: Reciprocal motif probability
parameters.help: Probability of adding a two-hidden-neuron reciprocal motif.

parameters.label: Initial hidden nodes
parameters.help: Hidden nodes placed in each initial NEAT genome.

parameters.label: Add-node probability
parameters.help: NEAT probability of splitting a connection with a new node.

parameters.label: Add-connection probability
parameters.help: NEAT probability of adding one connection.

parameters.label: Toggle-gene probability
parameters.help: Probability of toggling one connection gene.

parameters.label: Compatibility threshold
parameters.help: Maximum NEAT compatibility distance within a species.

parameters.label: Excess-gene coefficient
parameters.help: Compatibility coefficient for excess genes.

parameters.label: Disjoint-gene coefficient
parameters.help: Compatibility coefficient for disjoint genes.

parameters.label: Weight-distance coefficient
parameters.help: Compatibility coefficient for matching-gene weight differences.

parameters.label: Interspecies mating
parameters.help: Probability of choosing the second parent outside the first parent's species.

parameters.label: Objective set
parameters.help: Basic objectives or the extended set with neuron-count cost.

parameters.label: Target foods
parameters.help: Food target used to normalize task score.

parameters.label: Target spike rate
parameters.help: Spike-rate target used to normalize excess neural energy.

parameters.label: NSGA-II synapse budget
parameters.help: Enabled-synapse budget used by the structural objective.

parameters.label: NSGA-II neuron budget
parameters.help: Neuron budget used by the extended objective set.

parameters.label: Random seed
parameters.help: Seed for evolution and scenario generation.
